description: Source code for SQLMetrics class in Apache Spark, defining metrics used in SQL query plans, including creation, updating, and reporting of various metrics like size, timing, and averages.

classes.name: SQLMetric
classes.description: Represents a SQL query plan metric, implemented as an AccumulatorV2, supporting update, merge, and info reporting.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the SQLMetric instance with the same state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the metric value to its initial value.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another AccumulatorV2 into this one, combining their values.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Checks if the metric value is at its initial (invalid) state.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a non-negative long value to the metric.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the metric value, either from a double (for averages) or long.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the current metric value, converting invalid state to 0.

methods.name: toInfo
methods.description: Generates an AccumulableInfo object with metadata about the metric.

methods.name: toInfoUpdate
methods.description: Generates an AccumulableInfo object with the raw metric value for updates.
